answer: A farm faking 498 aliases needs 498 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The cipher is the wall and the violet is the gate: The seat is earned with press card with editors association: a card the association renews after published reporting years. A farm of 498 aliases must climb the wall 498 times, the vine ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
